text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, that movie was so fun♪ Heart-chan, 
buy me popcorn, buy me some~♡

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
What would you do without me? What a 
helpless child you are. Very well, I will 
buy some, but—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Okay. In return, you must clean your 
room's closet today, understand? Also, I 
will buy two different flavors so you can 
share with me♪

I ran into the roommate duo right after 
their movie. Daring Heart felt almost like 
Fusaichi Pandora's...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, do you think so? Surprisingly, rather 
than mother and child, wouldn't you say we 
are "best friends"?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, best friends♪ Heart-chan and I 
totally match when it comes to the things 
we like!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Pandora, what did you enjoy most 
about that western action movie we just 
watched, "The Praised One"?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, definitely the final battle 
scene☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Like, punch—BAM, whoosh, zoom into the 
face, and crash through the window! It got 
me so hyped, just like a theme park ride♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I see. I found the psychological thrill to 
be its true charm. The action was splendid 
as well, but—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It was precisely because of the mental 
maneuvering leading up to it that made the 
battle shine even brighter♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...So as you can see, the aspects that 
draw us in are completely different, 
however...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, we always end up loving 
the exact same things♡

Fusaichi Pandora and Daring Heart. Their 
personalities may differ, but deep down... 
something fundamental and fateful connects 
them.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
But! Even though our tastes align, the 
area where we completely differ is—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Now then, after the movie, let's play at 
the arcade!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Alrighty☆ Then rhythm games first!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
My, what happened, Pandora? You made it 
through that intense rush just fine.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oopsie! I let my guard down for a second 
and messed up! Ah, whoa, are you 
serious~?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah, Heart-chan, why do you never mess 
up~?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Fufu, my concentration is never broken♪

Daring Heart's score was always 
consistent. On the other hand, Fusaichi 
Pandora had a habit of slacking off...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Grrr, don't underestimate a genius~. I'm 
definitely gonna win the next one!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
When I get serious, I won't lose at 
anything. Hey hey, what should we play 
next?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Anything is fine. Pick whatever you like.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Racing game! Alright, I'm taking 1st 
place☆ Watch closely, here comes my best 
show!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Take this, take that☆ Overtaking from 
inside and outside all day long~♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yay, number one☆ This time I beat 
Heart-chan~♡

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's some explosive power! When it 
comes to clutching a crucial moment, I'm 
no match for you, Pandora.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That latent power of yours that I lack... 
I wonder who you inherited it from. How 
envious♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Drum game! Alright, let's drum-roll away! 
Time to show off my best performance!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ready, set, go!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Don-doko, chaka-poko tan-tan♪ Pon-poko, 
jan-jaka jan-jan☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yay, number one☆ This time I beat 
Heart-chan~♡

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's some explosive power! When it 
comes to clutching a crucial moment, I'm 
no match for you, Pandora.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That latent power of yours that I lack... 
I wonder who you inherited it from. How 
envious♪
